transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Hi Doctor. I'm visiting because I've been struggling a lot with focusing and listening when people talk to me. I've also been really forgetful in my daily routine lately and keep losing important items.
Do you also often feel very restless or fidgety, have trouble sitting still, or act impulsively before thinking?

Yes, I frequently feel this internal restlessness and have a really hard time just sitting still. I also tend to act impulsively, often interrupting others or cutting into conversations and activities before I can stop myself.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)], but the patient now clearly endorses hyperactive/impulsive symptoms in addition to inattention (internal restlessness, difficulty sitting still, interrupting/cutting into conversations), making the predominantly inattentive presentation unlikely. The current candidate is therefore ADHD, Combined Presentation.
